def score(program: str) -> float:
    "~^|"
    n = max(len(program), 1)
    chars = min(len(set(program)), 200) / 500
    size = min(n, 4000) / 10000
    space = sum(c.isspace() for c in program) / n * 0.2
    return chars + size + space
